about: Identity exceptions for portal/public/photos/people.json, read by scripts/photo_identity.mjs (the map check) and scripts/backfill_photos_oa.py. same_person: a roster spelling whose first name does not agree with the portrait owner's name but is verified to be the same person, so the check lets that one name use that one key. wrong_face: a portrait file that shows somebody other than the person who owns its key; no name may map to it, and backfill_photos_oa.py will not map it, until the file is replaced and looked at. docs/PHOTOS.md, 'Identity check'.

antony windsor.why: Tony Windsor (New England); Antony is his given name

david tollner.why: Dave Tollner (Solomon 2001-2007); the only Tollner in the House

katrina allen.why: Katie Allen (Higgins 2019-2022); Katrina is her given name
